description:
Prepare an ABINIT input file: resolve pseudopotentials, auto-fill ecut, and optionally
    generate workflow inputs (NLO, phonons, bands, GW) using AbiPy.

    At least one of input_file or structure_file must be provided.

    Args:
        input_file (Optional[Path]): Path to the .abi input file (template). Omit if generating from structure only.
        structure_file (Optional[Path]): Path to structure file (CIF/POSCAR/etc.). Used to generate input or replace template structure.
        program (str): ABINIT executable: "abinit" | "optic" | "anaddb" | "mrgddb".
        pseudo_family (str): Built-in pseudo set: "oncv_pbe_sr" (NC psp8) or "jth_pbe" (PAW xml).
        custom_pseudo_dir (Optional[str]): Directory with user-provided pseudos (overrides built-in).
        workflow_type (Optional[str]): None | "nlo" | "phonons" | "bands" | "gw".
            None     → only patch pseudos/ecut.
            "nlo"    → AbiPy dte_from_gsinput() → DFPT multi-dataset + optic.inp.
            "phonons"→ AbiPy phonons_from_gsinput().
            "bands"  → AbiPy ebands_input().
            "gw"     → AbiPy g0w0_with_ppmodel_inputs().
        ecut_accuracy (str): "low" | "medium" | "high". Auto-fills ecut from pseudo hints if unset.
        autoparal_ncpus (Optional[int]): If set, query ABINIT binary for optimal parallel config.
        previous_calc_files (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): {ird_variable: file_path} for linking to previous outputs
            (workflow_type=None only). E.g. {"irdwfk": "/path/to/out_WFK"}.
        output_dir (Optional[str]): Output directory (defaults to input_file's or structure_file's parent).

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: prepared_files (list[Path]), asset_manifest, runtime_hints, warnings.
name: prepare_abinit_job

description:
Prepare a CP2K input file: patch file paths, KIND blocks, MGRID/KPOINTS, and
    typed overrides (MD, GEO_OPT, CELL_OPT, NEB, VIBE, bands).

    All modifications go through cp2k-input-tools parse→dict→merge→validate→generate,
    validated against the full cp2k_input.xml keyword database.

    Args:
        input_file (Path): Path to the CP2K input file (.inp).
        basis_set_files (Optional[list]): List of basis set file paths (BASIS_SET_FILE_NAME). Multiple allowed.
        potential_files (Optional[list]): List of potential file paths (POTENTIAL_FILE_NAME). Multiple allowed.
        structure_file (Optional[Path]): Structure file (CIF/POSCAR/XYZ/…) to inject into the input.
            Replaces literal &COORD/&CELL blocks in the template with coordinates and lattice vectors
            from the structure, and rebuilds &KIND entries to match the real element set.
            Also supports magic-string placeholders __CELL_BLOCK__ / __ATOMIC_COORDINATES_BLOCK__.
        wfn_restart_file (Optional[Path]): WFN restart file path (SCF/WFN_RESTART_FILE_NAME).
        md_restart_file (Optional[Path]): MD restart file path (MOTION/MD/RESTART_FILE_NAME).
        dftd3_data_dir (Optional[str]): DFT-D3 parameter file directory.
        include_files (Optional[list]): Extra @INCLUDE files to copy to output_dir.
        basis_set_map (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): Per-element basis set names, e.g. {"Si": "DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH"}.
        potential_map (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): Per-element GTH potential names, e.g. {"Si": "GTH-PBE-q4"}.
        admm_basis_map (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): Per-element ADMM auxiliary basis sets. Also enables ADMM.
        cutoff (Optional[float]): MGRID/CUTOFF [Ry].
        rel_cutoff (Optional[float]): MGRID/REL_CUTOFF [Ry].
        kpoints (Optional[str]): KPOINTS/SCHEME string, e.g. "MONKHORST-PACK 3 3 3".
        neb_replica_files (Optional[list]): Ordered list of structure files for NEB replicas.
        overrides (Optional[Dict[str, Any]]): Typed overrides dict (Cp2kOverrides-compatible) for run_type, SCF, MD,
            GEO_OPT, CELL_OPT, NEB, VIBE, bands. Example:
            {"run_type": "MD", "motion": {"md": {"ensemble": "NVT", "temperature": 300,
            "timestep": 0.5, "steps": 10000}}}.
        output_dir (Optional[str]): Output directory (defaults to input_file's parent).

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: prepared_files (list[Path]), asset_manifest, runtime_hints, warnings.
name: prepare_cp2k_job

description:
Prepare a Quantum ESPRESSO input file.

    At least one of input_file or structure_file must be provided.
    pw.x is handled via pymatgen PWInput (structured). ph.x, neb.x, pp.x, bands.x,
    dos.x are handled via targeted regex patching.

    Args:
        input_file (Optional[Path]): Path to the QE input file (template). Omit if generating from structure only.
        structure_file (Optional[Path]): Structure file to inject or use to generate full input.
        program (str): QE executable: "pw.x" | "ph.x" | "neb.x" | "pp.x" | "bands.x" | "dos.x".
        outdir (Optional[str]): &CONTROL/outdir. Must match the SCF run's outdir for post-processing programs.
        pseudo_dir (Optional[str]): &CONTROL/pseudo_dir (pw.x only).
        calculation (Optional[str]): &CONTROL/calculation: "scf"|"nscf"|"bands"|"relax"|"vc-relax"|"md".
        pseudo_map (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): Per-species pseudopotential filenames.
        kpoints_mode (Optional[str]): K_POINTS mode: "automatic" | "crystal_b" | "gamma".
        kpoints_grid (Optional[list]): K-point grid [nx, ny, nz] for automatic mode.
        kpoints_path (Optional[list]): Band-structure k-path for crystal_b mode.
        system_overrides (Optional[Dict[str, Any]]): Flat dict of &SYSTEM overrides, e.g. {"ecutwfc": 60}.
        neb_replica_files (Optional[list]): Ordered list of structure files for NEB replicas.
        output_dir (Optional[str]): Output directory (defaults to input_file's or structure_file's parent).
        pseudo_family (str): Bundled pseudopotential family to use for auto-resolution. Currently supported: 'sssp_efficiency'.
        auto_pseudo (bool): Enable automatic pseudopotential resolution from bundled library. When true, if no pseudo_dir is provided or the existing pseudo_dir is invalid, pseudopotentials will be auto-resolved from the bundled library. Set to false to disable this behavior.

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: prepared_files (list[Path]), asset_manifest, runtime_hints, warnings.
name: prepare_qe_job

description:
Prepare a LAMMPS input file: patch structure path and force field paths.

    At least one of input_file or structure_file must be provided.
    Uses pymatgen LammpsInputFile for structured patching (not regex).
    Supports DeePMD, ReaxFF, and classical (EAM/Tersoff/SW/AIREBO) force fields.

    Args:
        input_file (Optional[Path]): Path to the LAMMPS input script. Omit to generate only structure data file.
        structure_file (Optional[Path]): Structure file to use as read_data target or to generate .data file.
        potential (Optional[Dict[str, Any]]): Force field specification dict. Exactly one of:
            {"deepmd": {"model_files": ["model.pb"], "type_map": ["Fe", "O"]}}
            {"reaxff": {"ffield_file": "ffield.reax", "element_order": ["Fe", "O"],
                        "control_file": "lmp_control"}}
            {"classical": {"potential_file": "Fe.eam.alloy", "element_order": ["Fe"]}}
            Pass null/None for embedded force fields (OPLS/CHARMM/AMBER/LJ).
        output_dir (Optional[str]): Output directory (defaults to input_file's or structure_file's parent).

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: prepared_files (list[Path]), asset_manifest, runtime_hints, warnings.
name: prepare_lammps_job

description:
Prepare an ORCA input file (three modes: template-only, structure-only, template+structure).

    Three input modes (exactly one valid combination must hold):

    1. Template-only: provide only input_file. The template is validated (must contain at least one
       "!" line and balanced "%...end" blocks) and written as-is. Use when the template already
       contains coordinates or you will fill them manually.

    2. Structure-only: provide structure_file and orcasimpleinput (no input_file). A full .inp is
       generated from the method line and structure coordinates. Use when you do not have a
       template and want to generate the input from scratch.

    3. Template+structure: provide input_file and structure_file. The template must contain either
       __ATOMIC_COORDINATES_BLOCK__ or a * xyz charge mult ... * block. Coordinates from the
       structure file are injected or replace that block. charge and multiplicity are used for
       the coordinate block.

    Template validation raises explicit errors (no silent fallbacks): missing "!" line, unclosed
    "%" block, or (when structure is to be injected) missing coordinate slot — each error
    message states the exact failure (e.g. line number, block name, or what is missing).

    Args:
        input_file (Optional[Path]): Path to ORCA input template (.inp). Required for
            template-only and template+structure. File must exist; content must pass
            validate_orca_template. If structure_file is also given, template must contain
            __ATOMIC_COORDINATES_BLOCK__ or a * xyz ... * block.
        structure_file (Optional[Path]): Path to structure file (CIF/POSCAR/XYZ/mol2). Required
            for structure-only; optional with input_file to inject/replace coordinates.
        orcasimpleinput (Optional[str]): Content of the "!" simple keyword line — everything
            after the "!" character. Required for structure-only mode; ignored when input_file
            is provided (the template owns the method line). Supported content includes any
            valid ORCA simple keyword combination, for example:
              - DFT:                 "B3LYP def2-TZVP"
              - Hybrid DFT + D3:     "B3LYP-D3BJ def2-TZVP TightSCF"
              - HF:                  "HF def2-SVP"
              - MP2:                 "MP2 def2-TZVP"
              - CCSD(T):             "CCSD(T) def2-TZVPP"
              - TDDFT:               "TD-B3LYP def2-TZVP"
              - Geometry opt:        "B3LYP def2-TZVP Opt"
              - Frequency:           "B3LYP def2-TZVP Freq"
              - NMR:                 "B3LYP def2-TZVP NMR"
              - Solvation (CPCM):    "B3LYP def2-TZVP CPCM(water)"
              Multiple keywords are space-separated on a single string; do not include the
              leading "!".
        orcablocks (Optional[str]): Raw text of one or more "%...end" input blocks.
            Optional in all modes; used when generating from scratch (structure-only), appended
            after the "!" line. Supported blocks include:
              - Parallelism:         "%pal
  nprocs 8
end"
              - Memory per core:     "%maxcore 4000"  (no 'end' required for single-variable blocks)
              - SCF control:         "%scf
  convergence tight
  maxiter 200
end"
              - DFT grid:            "%method
  grid 5
  finalgrid 6
end"
              - Geometry opt:        "%geom
  maxiter 100
end"
              - TDDFT:               "%tddft
  nroots 10
  iroot 1
end"
              - CASSCF:              "%casscf
  nel 6
  norb 6
end"
              - Basis per atom:      "%basis
  NewGTO C "def2-TZVP"
end"
              - Output:              "%output
  print[p_mulliken] 1
end"
              - Electric properties: "%elprop
  Dipole true
  Quadrupole true
  Polar true
  Hyperpol true
end"
                (keys are space-separated from values, no '=' needed; multiple properties per block)
              Multiple blocks should be newline-separated within the single string.
        charge (int): Total charge. Default 0. Used when building coordinates in structure-only
            or template+structure mode.
        multiplicity (int): Spin multiplicity (2S+1). Must be >= 1. Default 1.
        output_dir (Optional[str]): Directory to write the prepared .inp. Defaults to
            input_file's parent (template modes) or structure_file's parent (structure-only).

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: prepared_files (list[Path]), asset_manifest (input_mode, structure_file,
            charge, multiplicity, orcasimpleinput when applicable), runtime_hints, warnings.

    Raises:
        ValueError: Invalid parameter combination (e.g. no input_file and no structure_file+orcasimpleinput),
            or multiplicity < 1. From template validation: missing "!" line, unclosed "%" block,
            or (when structure_file given) no __ATOMIC_COORDINATES_BLOCK__ or * xyz ... * in template.
            Message states the exact failure (e.g. "Unclosed % block at line N: block name '...'").
        FileNotFoundError: input_file or structure_file path does not exist.

    Example (template-only):
        prepare_orca_job(input_file=Path("job.inp"))
    Example (structure-only):
        prepare_orca_job(structure_file=Path("mol.xyz"), orcasimpleinput="B3LYP def2-TZVP")
    Example (template+structure):
        prepare_orca_job(input_file=Path("t.inp"), structure_file=Path("mol.xyz"), charge=0, multiplicity=1)
name: prepare_orca_job

description:
Prepare a pyATB job: validate directory structure and bind ABACUS result directory.

    Args:
        work_dir (Path): Directory containing the pyATB Input file.
        abacus_result_dir (Optional[Path]): Path to the ABACUS output directory containing HR.csr, SR.csr, etc.

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: prepared_files (list[Path]), asset_manifest, runtime_hints, warnings.
name: prepare_pyatb_job
